title: Thermal Concentration and Poisson-Dirichlet Edge Statistics for Random-Lattice Gibbs Ensembles
summary: We study Gibbs measures on high-dimensional Haar-random unimodular lattices, where the energy of a lattice vector is its squared Euclidean norm. The random lattice is viewed as quenched geometric disorder, and $c>0$ denotes the scaled inverse temperature. We first analyze the edge window of vectors whose length is within the factor $e^{a/n}$ of the shortest length, with fixed $a$ as $n\to\infty$.
